bugs.what: The notice board/hunter's tally pointed to a 'sunken shrine' and 'old watchtower' verse location within the Vale of Ash, but after ~100 turns of searching the Vale and adjacent Fenmarch I never found either; status kept listing them as 'unexplored' even after Act I was fully completed via crown-return instead.

'Backtrack for the long way round' at The Washed Ford consumes a turn and flavor text implies progress ('you cross dry') but leaves you in the exact same room with the same menu and no new destinations unlocked — reads like it should have advanced you somewhere.

A single hold (Fenmarch) alone consumed ~100 turns once side-quests and companion content were engaged, and the game's own guidance ('40-70 turns per hold, 15 holds, 300-turn ceiling') makes the advertised 'big' ending (3 hollows rested + Vale king + first Reeve's confession, or reaching Marrowgate) effectively unreachable in one sitting for a thorough player, even one moving with clear intent rather than wandering.

confusions: The 'sunken shrine' and 'old watchtower' verse locations were never surfaced by any NPC dialogue or exploration despite fairly exhaustive coverage of the Vale — no compass/hint pointed at where to look, unlike the barrow-hall verse and the hunter's-camp tally clue for the hidden barrow entrance.

It wasn't obvious up front that companion regard could drop low enough to lose a party member (Vell hit 'near leaving' at -2 after one story choice); the status screen was the only place this surfaced, and only when explicitly checked.

The overall shape of the game (15 sprawling holds, a 300+ turn full campaign) only became clear well into Act II via the status recap — the opening pitch undersold the scale, so early pacing decisions (e.g. diving deep into Fenmarch) were made without knowing the true budget.
suggestions: Surface the sunken shrine / old watchtower locations through some in-Vale NPC or object the way the hunter's tally marks surfaced the hidden barrow entrance.
Give the 'long way round' ford detour an actual destination or explicitly say 'no new path' so it doesn't read as a missed unlock.
Warn players earlier (e.g. at first status check) that a full 3-hollow ending realistically needs 150-200+ turns, so they can pace hold selection deliberately from the start.
Show a lightweight regard/'about to leave' warning inline when a companion's approval crosses a danger threshold, rather than only on-demand via status.
